properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. @ajs, 2026-10-18: "On our lines of reasoning efforts for reflow2 have we considered: 1. General Graph Terminology (The Mathematical Basis) … a line of reasoning is represented as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) … 2. Standard Diagramming Frameworks: A. Toulmin Model … Claim, Grounds/Data, Warrant, Backing, Qualifier, Rebuttal. B. Dung's Abstract Argumentation Frameworks … Arguments (A) … Attack Relation (R) … support is often modeled indirectly (… 'defense'). C. IBIS … Issues, Positions, Arguments (+/−). 3. … Contention / Main Conclusion, Premise, Co-Premise ('AND' gate), Support Link, Attack / Refutation Link. 4. … Inference Networks (conditional probabilities or logical implications) … Carneades … 'statement nodes' and 'argument nodes' … proof standards (preponderance of evidence vs. beyond a reasonable doubt) …"

The design held none of these frameworks by name before this. WHAT REFLOW2 ALREADY HAS, as a finding (read from the design and today's trials, not re-measured):
- DAG: one step concludes one node, and a circle of support is refused where it is written (refuse_an_unsound_step_link).
- Claim, Grounds, Premise, Contention: a conclusion; its step's premises; the roots of reasoning_report.
- Co-premise vs convergent: a step's rule `all` is the AND gate; two steps concluding one claim are convergent lines, checked independent with independent_of / independent_except.
- Warrant: a step's `warrant`, but only as TEXT. Nothing can support it or attack it.
- Rebuttal / attack link: an opposing CONTRADICTS, counted "as far as it holds" (dec:an-objection-counts-as-far-as-it-holds). It refutes when it holds, contests while unknown, and stops counting once answered. That is Dung's "defense" (reinstatement), computed recursively.
- Carneades' two node kinds: reflow2 already splits statements (Requirement / Constraint with statement_kind) from steps (Inference).
- IBIS: an issue is a proposed Decision or a Question; positions are its options or registered alternatives. Pro and con are not typed links on an option.

WHAT IS NOT THERE (candidate ideas, none chosen):
(a) BACKING: a warrant that is its own statement, which can be supported and attacked.
(b) UNDERCUTTING: an objection against the STEP (that these premises support this conclusion), as distinct from one against a premise or the conclusion (Pollock's undercutting vs rebutting defeat; Toulmin's rebuttal as an exception to the warrant). Not yet measured whether a CONTRADICTS can target an Inference today.
(c) QUALIFIER: a stated strength on a claim or step ("presumably", "highly likely"), shown, never computed.
(d) PROOF STANDARDS PER CLAIM (Carneades): what it takes for a claim to count. Deductive (every premise, every step) for mathematics; preponderance, clear and convincing, or beyond reasonable doubt for an argument or a legal case. Today every claim is held to one standard (all/any/k_of_n over holds/fails/unknown).
(e) DUNG SEMANTICS FOR CYCLES OF ATTACK: two objections that attack each other. Grounded semantics leaves both undecided; preferred semantics gives two consistent readings. Not yet measured what reflow2's recursive evaluation does with such a cycle.
(f) AN IBIS READ-BACK: issue → positions → pros and cons, read from what is already recorded (Decision, alternatives, supporting and opposing links).
(g) DEGREES (inference networks): conditional probabilities on links.

PUSHBACK, RECORDED BESIDE THEM:
- FEWER THINGS (dec:idea-reflow2-does-fewer-things-and-does-them-really-well). Most of this is already in reflow2 under its own names. Six Toulmin TYPES would grow the schema and the tool surface. Where an idea survives, a role or property on what exists is cheaper than a new node type.
- THE AGENT / REFLOW2 LINE (@ajs, 2026-10-17). reflow2 records structure and computes deterministic readings. Grounded semantics (e) and per-claim proof standards (d) are deterministic computations, so they are reflow2's. Judging whether a warrant is GOOD, or a qualifier deserved, is the agent's or the person's, never reflow2's.
- DUNG STRIPS THE WORDS. That is the opposite of rung 2's lesson (the read-back must keep them). Dung is useful as an evaluation rule, never as the representation.
- PROBABILITIES ON ARGUMENTS (g) are mostly false precision. The kept idea (f) of dec:idea-what-reflow2-can-learn-from-evaluator-guided-llm-circuit-design (sampled evidence with a stated bound) covers the one case where a number is honest. (g) is much larger than the others: it needs a calculus, not a field.
- IT CAME FROM READING. rule:an-idea-from-reading-waits-for-a-real-use-before-it-is-built (advisory). The philosophical trials proposed beside this (dec:idea-philosophical-arguments-as-trials-of-a-line-of-reasoning) and Chris's argument are the real uses that would show which of (a)–(g) are needed.

SIZE, as a finding: (f) small, a read over what exists. (b), (c) and (e) small to medium. (a) and (d) medium. (g) large.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-18: from the argumentation frameworks, reflow2 keeps (f) an issue/positions read-back, (b) an objection against a step, and (d) a proof standard per claim; (a), (c), (e) and (g) stay considered until a trial shows the need
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill. The design was searched first for Toulmin, Dung, IBIS, Carneades, proof standards and philosophical trials; none was recorded. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
